title: Alternate suit 5: Don Cherry red-orange tartan and ivory dotted tie

clothingReference.description: Owner-attached Don Cherry red-orange tartan suit photograph
clothingReference.adaptation: Clothing pattern, colours and ivory dotted tie adapted onto the existing robot poses. Human anatomy, thumbs-up stance, boutonniere and jacket button construction were not copied. Photograph remains local and is not distributed.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Coach's Corner animated character transparent PNG master.
Input 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET: the silver Don robot in his normal default listening pose. Input 2 is CLOTHING REFERENCE ONLY: Don Cherry in the iconic red-orange tartan suit. Change ONLY the robot jacket fabric and tie to match that clothing.
Match the photo's warm vivid burnt orange/red-orange tartan: large regular square checks made of broad deep black vertical and horizontal bands crossed by fine paired ivory-white pinstripes, with muted rust-red overlapping bands. Plaid follows jacket lapels and sleeves, not a flat grid pasted on. Keep the original robot's jacket cut, white pointed high shirt collar and cuffs, folded white pocket square and small black lapel microphone. Replace striped navy tie with ivory/cream tie covered in tiny evenly spaced dark black dots. No poppy, boutonniere, extra accessories, double-breasted buttons or human anatomy.
Preserve exactly input 1's silver robot head and body, cyan eyes, white metal swept hair, connected white moustache and broad goatee, closed mouth seam, expression, head and shoulder anchors, clasped low hands, scale, margins, silhouette, lighting and camera angle. Same detailed cel-shaded polished illustration and dark outlines. Don sits left facing slightly screen-right. Do not mirror or copy the photo's thumbs-up pose. One pose only, same full untrimmed 1254 by 1254 square canvas.
True transparent alpha background including arm gaps. No desk, chair, scenery, floor, shadow plane, text or watermark. This is Alternate suit 5, a nonholiday wardrobe.
assets.postprocessing: Original generated 1254 by 1254 RGBA PNG preserved byte-for-byte. WebP quality 94 at 1254 and 640 pixels; no alpha modification. AVIF uses existing coachs:assets recipe.
